verifications.notes: The update query updates an invoice by id without filtering on the authenticated user’s id, and no role or ownership check is present in the visible code.
The view action selects a user by id from the request without any ownership or role guard; the included auth file only verifies login.
The delete action deletes a user by id from the request without any ownership or role guard; the included auth file only verifies login.
The delete_user script deletes a user by id from the request without any ownership or role guard; the included auth file only verifies login.
The promote script updates a user’s role based on an id from the request without any ownership or role guard; the included auth file only verifies login.
